name: East India Drums & Barrels Manufacturing Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Precision Containeurs Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing Drums & Barrels.
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1][2]
Company manufactures variety of small, large, and intermediate Plastic & Metal barrels and Mild Steel Barrels with capacities ranging from 50 liters to 200 liters. Company also manufactures plastic fuel tanks. Steel barrels and drums are mainly used for storage and transport of oils, solvents, and chemicals mostly in liquid and semi-solid form. Steel barrels are used for packing petroleum, lubricants and chemicals.

cons: Stock is trading at 7.63 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
